mostWorthwhile.text: The closing passage was worthwhile: it brings hydrogen, stellar oxygen, stone and the Moon together without implying the sea was inevitable.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final chapter offered no actions, so there was no gameplay decision to evaluate.

surprise.text: The story ends with an empty board and a brief reflection rather than another combination.

arbitrary.text: I made no gameplay choices in this chapter, so I cannot identify an arbitrary action.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue for more explanations of natural processes, though this closing chapter alone did not let me assess how its gameplay feels.
